register.labelZh: STEP 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: step aside 和 step down 可以描述領袖、經理或隊長離開職位。；step back 可以表示某人先停下來,以較冷靜或全面的角度看待問題。；step forward 表示自願提供協助;step in 則表示在有需要時介入或接手。；step on it 可以叫人快一點;step out 則表示某人只是短暫離開。
register.summaryEn: Step aside and step down allow you to describe a leader, manager or team captain leaving a role. Step back can show that someone pauses and looks at a problem from a calmer or wider point of view. Step forward describes volunteering, while step in describes helping or taking control when someone is needed. Step on it tells someone to hurry, while step out explains that someone has left only briefly.

fixedVariable.fixedZh: 閱讀整句,選出意思相同的 STEP 片語動詞。
fixedVariable.fixedEn: Read the whole sentence and choose the STEP expression that gives the same meaning.
fixedVariable.variableZh: 保留原句中的人物、事物、時間和意思。；step aside 和 step down 都可以表示離開重要職位。後面的字詞只用來補充資料。；主要表達後面的字詞只用來補充資料,並非每次都必須出現。step on it 則是表示「快點」的完整表達。
fixedVariable.variableEn: Keep the same people, things, time and meaning. Step aside and step down can both describe leaving an important position. Extra words may give more information: step down step down as captain step down from the role step aside and let someone else lead The words after the main expression are not always part of the fixed expression: step forward to help step in for somebody step out for ten minutes Step on it is the complete expression meaning “hurry”.
